full_judgment: 2. The prosecution case, in brief, was that on 17.4.1980 at about 10-30 AM one Shamim Ara Sultana alias Sawpna, daughter of one Nawab Miah of 26, Debendra Nath Das Lane, Dhaka was found dead by hanging with her wearing same in the bathroom of her husband Tariq Habibullah in the first floor of 10, Rajani Chowdhury Road, Dhaka. Suspecting the occurrence to be one of murder Nawab Miah, the father of the deceased, lodged an information with the Sutrapur Police Station claiming that his daughter has been murdered by his son-in-law or by someone in her father in-law's house and accordingly UD Case No. 8 dated 17.4.80 was started. The SI of Police Kanchan Ali Talukder of Sutrapur PS visited the place of occurrence, held inquest and sent the dead body to the Mitford Hospital for post mortem examination. Thereafter SI of Police Mohammad Manir Hossain Bhuiyan of Detective Branch, Dhaka Metropolitan Police, took over the investigation and on the basis of the available materials lodged a suo motu First Information Report being Sutrapur PS Case No. 20 dated 9.5.80 against the accused-appellant Tarique Habibullah, his friend Iqbal Tariq, who was living in a nearby house, and also against the accused-appellant's mother Mrs. Suraiya Begum.
